bagPolicy.summary: Clear plastic, vinyl or PVC bags up to 12 × 6 × 12 inches and nonclear clutches or fanny packs up to 6 × 9 inches with at most one pocket are permitted.
allowed: One-pocket clutch or fanny pack up to 6 × 9 inches
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Unless the show says otherwise, general and reserved parking cost $25 per vehicle; VIP parking is $35 per vehicle first come, first served. Lots normally open two hours before showtime.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: For rideshare pickup or drop-off, enter the VIP parking entrance off State Avenue and follow the signs; the same approach handles accessible drop-off.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Food and drink vendors sell BBQ, hot dogs, pretzels and beverages. Concessions accept cards only; one factory-sealed plastic water bottle up to one liter is permitted per person.
allowed: One sealed water bottle up to one liter
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Accessible guests should use the VIP parking entrance off State Avenue for drop-off and pickup; the FAQ does not give detailed seating instructions.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The amphitheater policy and FAQ page does not state a re-entry rule.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: The box office off 130th Street opens Fridays from 10 a.m. to 4 p.m.; the venue does not publish a general will-call procedure.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Lots generally open two hours before showtime and gates one hour before; exact times appear on the event page one or two days before the concert.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
